newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB breaks through 600p level to new peak.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB breaks through 600p level to new peak.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Plc set a record high on Friday, with some traders talking about a chart breakout once it had moved through 600p.
The stock was up 12p at 606-1/2 by 1039 GMT in active trade of 2.1 million shares, surpassing the previous peak of 598p set October 1.
One dealer said the stock had risen after a buyer had appeared in the market at 598p.

Another analyst, who asked not to be named, pointed out the stock had gained strength this week from reports that BSkyB was seeking an equity stake in the proposed pay TV joint venture between Flextech and the British Broadcasting Corp.
"BSkyB seems confident it can extract something from the deal," the analyst said.
